correctness.rationale: The trace representation over F25 with gamma^2+gamma+2=0 (order 24) gives an explicit four-dimensional F5 code whose ordinary enumerator is exactly 1+108 z^16+288 z^19+24 z^20+192 z^21+12 z^24. Deleting coordinate 0 gives the published [23,4,15] enumerator; the coordinate-0 kernel has dimension 3 and gives the published [23,3,16] enumerator. Full rank of both generators identifies all r-subcodes bijectively with RREF rowspaces of F5^4 and F5^3. Each support is exactly the union of nonzero positions in any rowspace basis. Independent arithmetic reconstructed field multiplication and trace, independently enumerated all 1119 punctured and 63 shortened nonzero subspaces, and exactly reproduced each support histogram, hierarchy (15,19,22,23)/(16,20,23), and minimizer count (18,5,23,1)/(9,1,1). Exhaustive finite claim requires no extrapolation.
residual_risks: Claim concerns only the specific q=5 shortened/punctured pair, not all-q formulas.
Other code equivalences could change the originality comparison but not the exact enumerations.
